notes: Source is the official RTS/Bosch "Zeus III LE and LE+" Technical Data Sheet (Form F01U281930 Rev 02, April 2013), which covers both the Zeus III LE (single power supply) and Zeus III LE+ (dual/failover power supply) as one document. This entry models the base Zeus III LE (single PSU, single AC inlet); the LE+ variant is identical except for a second IEC inlet and a second Power LED. GPI and RELAYS 1&2 connectors are drawn as DB-9/DB-25 D-sub connectors in the official line drawing, which are not in the allowed connector-id list; they were mapped to the closest available id (euroblock) as an approximation - actual hardware uses D-sub, not euroblock terminal blocks. TRUNK/TO PC is a single physical DB-9 combo connector serving both RS232 (PC/AZedit) and RS485 (trunk) functions per spec text, also approximated since DB-9 is not in the allowed list. USB port type/speed and exact connector shape (USB-A vs USB-B/Mini) are not stated in the data sheet. No HDMI/SDI/video ports exist on this device - it is a pure audio intercom matrix, so type "Other" and category "control" were chosen since no listed category/type precisely fits a digital intercom matrix (closest alternatives would be "audio"/"Audio mixer" or "network"/"Network switch", none of which are accurate). Keypanel RJ45 ports carry balanced analog audio (8dBu nominal, 20dBu max) plus RS485 data - no bandwidth grade applies since RJ45 here is not Ethernet-speed graded (only the dedicated ETHERNET port is 10/100Mbps and got eth-100m). Rack width 19in, height 1U (1.72in), depth 15in, weight 7.0lb.

ports.name: PORT 1-16
ports.note: 16x RJ45 keypanel ports; each carries RS485 keypanel data plus balanced 4-wire audio in/out for keypanel or audio device connection. Modeled as one representative port; device has 16 of these.

ports.name: CH. A (2W/Party Line)
ports.note: Party line channel A, configurable for RTS TW, Audiocom, or Clear-Com party-line protocols; balanced 2-wire.

ports.name: CH. B (2W/Party Line)
ports.note: Party line channel B, configurable for RTS TW, Audiocom, or Clear-Com party-line protocols; balanced 2-wire.

ports.name: ETHERNET
ports.note: 10/100Mbps for remote AZedit configuration, GPIO-16, or trunking data.

ports.name: TRUNK/TO PC
ports.note: DB-9 combo connector: RS232 PC port (AZedit, supports CPL) and RS485 trunk port for RTS trunked-system communication. Closest connector-id mapping; physically a DB-9 D-sub, not a round RS232/RS422 connector.

ports.name: GPIO-16/PAP/LCP
ports.note: Peripheral data port (DB-9) for GPIO-16 or LCP-102 peripheral devices.

ports.name: GPI
ports.note: General purpose input connector shown on rear panel as a DB-25 in the line drawing; DB-25 is not in the allowed connector list, so mapped to closest generic multi-pin I/O type (euroblock) as an approximation. Treat with caution.

ports.name: RELAYS 1&2
ports.note: Two relay contact outputs on a DB-9 connector; mapped to closest generic connector id since DB-9 is not in the allowed list.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Front-panel USB port for direct AZedit configuration. USB type/version (A vs B, speed) not specified on the data sheet; connector shape not confirmed from the front-panel line drawing beyond a generic USB port icon.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: 100-240VAC ~50-60Hz IEC power inlet. Zeus III LE (base model) has a single power supply/single inlet; the LE+ variant adds a second IEC inlet for redundant power.
